text: Review agent sessions alongside your outcome labels and feedback to decide where a context change could help
quote: Review your agent’s sessions alongside your outcome labels and feedback. Decide where a context change could help.

text: Teams define success with their own outcome labels, checks, and customer feedback
quote: Your team defines success using your own outcome labels, checks, and customer feedback. You write the context and choose its routing conditions.

text: See which agent mistakes repeat across production runs
quote: See which mistakes repeat across production runs.

text: You or your coding agent write a correction for a mistake and choose when to activate it
quote: You or your coding agent write the correction and choose when to activate it.

text: Delivers matching context to the agent mid-conversation with no redeploy or code change
quote: When a matching situation comes up again, Mirrors delivers the context mid-conversation. No redeploy, no code change.

text: Preview routing conditions against stored traces to see matches, misses, and unexpected matches before activation
quote: Preview your routing conditions against stored traces to review matches, misses, and unexpected matches before activation.

text: Compare sessions that received a correction against holdout groups using the outcomes your team tracks
quote: compare sessions that received your context with holdout groups using the outcomes your team tracks. Keep what helps, revise what doesn’t, or roll back a change.

text: Keep, revise, or roll back a context change based on its results
quote: Teams keep what helps, revise what does not, or roll a change back.

text: Corrections can append guidance, edit tool descriptions, tighten tool input schemas, or rewrite tool-result content shown to the model
quote: You can append guidance, edit a tool description, tighten a tool’s input schema, or rewrite the tool-result content shown to the model.

text: Routing decisions run locally, with no network request or model inference
quote: Routing decisions run locally, without a network request or model inference to decide what applies.

text: If no valid configuration is available, the agent continues without new context edits
quote: If no valid configuration is available, your agent continues without new context edits.

text: SDK waits at most 1,000 ms per user turn, with a configurable shorter limit, and proceeds without corrections on timeout
quote: The SDK waits at most 1,000 ms per user turn, and you can set a shorter limit. If Mirrors doesn’t answer in time, your agent continues without corrections.

text: Corrections reach only the situations where they belong, instead of growing a global system prompt
quote: A global prompt shows your agent the same instructions in every conversation... With Mirrors, each lesson reaches only the situations where it belongs

text: All corrections are managed in one place, scoped to accounts and workflows, and can be updated individually
quote: Every correction in one place. Scoped to accounts and workflows. Update one, not your whole prompt.

text: Works with the traces you already have
quote: Does Mirrors work with the traces I already have? Yes.

text: Supports agent frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Pydantic AI, smolagents, and Google ADK
quote: built for your agent’s context LangChain LangGraph LlamaIndex CrewAI AutoGen Pydantic AI smolagents Google ADK

text: Works with any agent framework while your app keeps control of its model calls and tools
quote: It works with any agent framework, and your app keeps control of its model calls and tools.

text: Capture uploads a full snapshot of the agent execution in the background
quote: Capture uploads a full snapshot in the background.

text: A final capture records how an execution ended after the last response, tool result, or stream event
quote: After the last response, tool result, or stream event — A final capture records how the execution ended.

text: When a correction matches, guidance is appended to the next model request's system prompt
quote: When a correction matches, your code appends that guidance to the next model request’s system prompt.

text: Shadow mode lets you verify capture and inspect failures before delivering corrections
quote: Start in shadow mode to verify capture and inspect failures.

text: Official npm package SDK connects to the agent's prompt and capture hooks
quote: Install the npm package and connect your agent’s prompt and capture hooks.

text: Recorded sessions show the changes applied and how many checks passed
quote: 5 changes · 3 of 4 checks passedRecorded session

text: Designed to complement observability and eval tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, and Braintrust
quote: Observability shows what an agent did, evals test a change, and corrections change what it gets in one situation. How they fit with Langfuse, LangSmith and Braintrust.
